rooms.name: Command
rooms.function: Start a run and advance the mission clock.

systems.name: Mission clock
systems.insight: A saved step advances mission time once.

systems.name: Navigation and waypoint ETA
systems.insight: Waypoint and arrival calculations are planned.

rooms.name: Habitat
rooms.function: House the four-person crew and track confirmed activity in the shared cabin.

systems.name: Shared air zone
systems.insight: Four astronauts share the same 100 m³ modeled air zone.

systems.name: Crew activity
systems.insight: Confirmed activity changes CO₂ generation from 06:00.

rooms.name: Life support
rooms.function: Monitor cabin atmosphere and remove carbon dioxide.

systems.name: Cabin CO₂ sensor
systems.insight: CO₂ rises after effective scrubber flow falls.

systems.name: Primary scrubber
systems.insight: The replay drops flow from 20 to 4 m³/h at 01:00.

systems.name: Standby readiness
systems.insight: Standby cannot be evaluated until the readiness check is connected.

rooms.name: Engineering
rooms.function: Track electrical headroom and power available to ship systems.

systems.name: Standby power check
systems.insight: Available headroom is shown while the standby decision model is pending.

rooms.name: Medical
rooms.function: Support private measurements and onboard emergency drills.

systems.name: Crew health
systems.insight: Crew measurements use the seven registered metric types.

systems.name: Emergency assist
systems.insight: Onboard training cases and acknowledgment are planned.

rooms.name: Communications
rooms.function: Deliver operational snapshots and acknowledgments to Ground.

systems.name: Ground relay
systems.insight: Ground reads the stored delivered packet and its age.

rooms.name: Cargo & docking
rooms.function: Track hatch readiness and payload custody for transfers.

systems.name: Hatch readiness
systems.insight: The future readiness check uses seal and pressure evidence.

systems.name: Payload manifest
systems.insight: Payload custody and transfer are planned.
